pages.title: Quiz Journey: Trivia Adventure
pages.creator: harooty
pages.description:
Quiz Journey: Trivia Adventure takes general-knowledge questions along a level map. Click or tap an answer, earn stars and coins, and develop a collection that includes rare items. You can also tap the question text to finish its typing animation immediately.

Four hint options help with difficult questions: 50/50 removes two incorrect answers, Ask the Audience offers assistance, Skip moves past a question and Shield provides protection. Daily rewards and a lucky wheel add more rewards to collect. Work through the questions and decide when a hint is useful as you continue the journey.

pages.title: Fire snake
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Fire snake asks you to guide a fiery snake safely home through a series of obstacle-filled levels. Steer around the dangers and collect coins and bonuses along the route.

Watch the path ahead before moving toward another pickup so that the snake can keep a clear way through. Reaching home is the objective, with each level presenting another arrangement of hazards to get past.

pages.title: DOP: Draw One Part
pages.creator: SayGames Ltd
pages.description:
DOP: Draw One Part is a picture puzzle about identifying an unfinished detail. Look at the image, work out what is missing and draw the part that makes the scene complete.

Each puzzle asks you to interpret what the picture is showing before adding your answer. Consider how the objects and characters fit together, then supply the missing feature that explains the scene or finishes its drawing.

pages.title: Card Master
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description:
Card Master is a merging puzzle about developing cards without filling the board. Place cards and bring identical ones together to make higher-level versions, building your score while managing the space left for future moves.

Special cards and boosts can help clear crowded areas. Check the available spaces before placing another card so that your next merge remains possible. The game ends when there are no moves left, making room management part of working toward stronger cards and larger combinations.

pages.title: Domino Solitaire
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description:
Domino Solitaire is a single-player tile puzzle with ninety levels. Choose a face-up domino whose end matches either side of the open tile below the board. Continue making matches to clear the layout.

When none of the exposed tiles match, click the closed pile to reveal another open domino. Wild-domino power-ups provide assistance when you are stuck. Look across the available tiles before making a choice so that you can continue the sequence and work toward removing the full arrangement.

pages.title: Airport Simulator Plane Tycoon
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description:
Airport Simulator Plane Tycoon puts you in charge of a growing airport. Start by helping travelers through check-in, then put the money you earn back into the airport. Hire workers to take on some of the daily jobs and upgrade the facilities so the airport can serve more passengers.

As you expand, you can develop terminals and runways and open more routes. Decide where your next investment will help most: adding room for more flights or improving the services passengers already use.

pages.title: Serious Head 2
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Serious Head 2 combines preparing a base with fighting monsters emerging from portals. Rebuild the defenses, improve your weapons and bring partners to help resist the attackers.

In build mode, keys 1-6 select a building, the left mouse button confirms and the right cancels. The wheel rotates the selection and R enters delete mode. During battle, move with WASD or the arrow keys, fire with the left mouse button and aim down the sights with the right. Use the wheel or number keys to change weapons, Space to jump and Z, X or C for abilities. Prepare the base before putting your equipment to use against the monsters.

pages.title: Magnetic Pull
pages.creator: Antore Games
pages.description:
Magnetic Pull is a physics puzzle about positioning metal objects with a magnet. Move the magnet using the arrow keys or drag it with the mouse, then press E to switch its force on or off.

Use the attraction to move, stack and arrange the metallic pieces as you work out the level's solution. Consider the magnet's position relative to the objects before activating it, adjusting both its placement and its timing to get the arrangement you need.

pages.title: Ultimate Destruction Simulator
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description:
Ultimate Destruction Simulator gives you towers to demolish and settings for changing how their destruction behaves. Shoot at structures, place explosive charges and experiment with gravity, debris, dust and destructibility. Time controls let you slow, accelerate or freeze the action while examining the collapse.

On a computer, WASD moves the camera and Q/E changes its height. The left mouse button fires, the wheel changes time speed and F freezes time. B opens weaponry and T starts the timer for placed charges. Press Escape twice for the menu. Other settings are available through the interface, letting you adjust the next demolition experiment.

pages.title: Last War Survival
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Last War Survival sends you into a zombie outbreak where staying alive takes both shooting and number puzzles. Fight off the enemies in your path and pay attention to the numbers when a challenge calls for a choice. Use the mouse or touch screen to play, and work through the encounters as you move through each level.

pages.title: Find It - Find The Differences
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description:
Find It - Find The Differences asks you to compare two nearly identical pictures and locate the details that have changed. Click the differences you discover, examining the small objects and features throughout each scene.

Look between the same areas of the two images as you search so that a subtle change is easier to recognize. Complete the comparison in the current picture pair to move through the game's different scenes.

pages.title: Penguin Adventure
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description:
Penguin Adventure sends a penguin toward the castle at the end of each level. Travel through three worlds while collecting stars and hearts that contribute to your score and rewards. Enough yellow stars are needed to unlock the next world.

On a computer, the Up arrow jumps, the Down arrow moves down and J throws projectiles. Mobile controls use the on-screen buttons. Keep the castle goal in mind while looking for pickups along the route, since the yellow-star requirement connects your collecting with further world progression.

pages.title: Rope King
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description:
Rope King is a rope-skipping game about timing a character's jumps through different challenges. Tap the screen to jump, watching the rope so that you choose the right moment to leave the ground.

The challenges use different rope-skipping situations and character actions. Keep checking the timing as the activity changes, then tap to bring your character through the next jump. The central task is coordinating those jumps with the moving rope.

pages.title: Hoard Master
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: In Hoard Master, you steer a moving hole and try to collect as many people as you can. Slide to move the hole beneath them, but watch the route you take through the area. An explosive can end the attempt if you swallow it, so go around the hazards even when people are close to them.

pages.title: Blast The Ball
pages.creator: P·Games
pages.description:
Blast The Ball challenges you to shoot and burst the balls required by each level. Work through one hundred levels, aiming to complete their targets while improving your score.

The game includes ten weapons and four bonuses, giving you different equipment to use during the shooting. Look at the balls you still need to destroy and choose how to use the available weapons as you work toward finishing the current level's target.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter FREE
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Bubble Shooter FREE is a bubble-cannon game about forming groups of at least three matching colors. Aim at the hanging cluster and fire to pop a matching group, keeping the formation from reaching the bottom of the screen.

Missed shots attach to the cluster, and fouls can bring the bubbles lower. Gray bubbles indicate those fouls, while a rainbow bubble clears bubbles it touches. Check the color of your next shot before aiming so that it can contribute to a match. Keep clearing space as the remaining bubbles and your shots change the arrangement.

pages.title: High School Anime Dress Up
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description:
High School Anime Dress Up lets you style anime schoolgirl characters with clothing and makeup. Choose the outfit you want, combining pieces from the wardrobe to create the character's appearance.

Use the left mouse button to change selections. When the look is complete, the Camera button creates a screenshot of the finished character. Try different clothing combinations as you put the outfit together, then use the picture feature when you want to capture the result.

pages.title: Mini Train io
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description:
Mini Train io turns snake-style movement into a growing-train challenge. Collect nuts and bolts to lengthen the train while steering around the other trains sharing the area. Colliding with another train ends the run.

Use the mouse or touch controls to guide your movement. Look for a route that reaches more parts without carrying your train into an opponent. As the train grows, keep room to maneuver and work toward a higher position on the leaderboard.

pages.title: Fairyland Merge & Magic
pages.creator: Clever Apps Pte. Ltd.
pages.description:
Fairyland Merge & Magic takes merging puzzles onto an island that you gradually uncover. Begin by combining a grape sprout with two others, continue developing the grape beds and harvest the results to produce a magic key. The key opens fog covering more of the island.

Work through the fairy exam and merging quests to discover additional items, characters and lands. The game includes a main story and side quests with rewards to collect. Look at the items needed for your next objective before deciding what to merge as you continue exploring Fairyland.

pages.title: Anigirls Wonderful Clicker
pages.creator: Isonia Universe
pages.description:
Anigirls Wonderful Clicker is a character-collection game in which clicking an anime heroine earns coins. Spend those coins on stronger clicks to increase the amount earned per press, or improve the character to raise overall earnings.

Character progression also makes more heroines available at ten-level intervals. Choose how to divide your earnings between the two upgrade paths while working toward the next character. The loop connects clicking, coin collection and improvements as you develop the collection.

pages.title: Fishing Duels
pages.creator: LazyLand SA
pages.description:
Fishing Duels is a two-player match-three contest about collecting fish before your opponent. Swap pieces on the ocean-floor board to make horizontal or vertical matches of at least three. The first player to gather the required number of fish wins.

The grid can contain up to eighty-one cells, with fishing equipment mixed among the orange fish. Matching items such as hooks, rods, bait and traps contributes to power-ups. Consider both the fish target and the equipment available as you choose a swap, using the board's opportunities to reach your collection goal first.

pages.title: STORMBREAKER
pages.creator: wey.game
pages.description:
STORMBREAKER puts you in a fighter jet with ground targets to destroy and hostages to rescue. Use weapons such as lasers and missiles to attack the enemy positions, clearing the required targets so that you can advance.

Look at the map and the location of each enemy before deciding where to direct the next attack. Both destruction and rescue are part of the mission, so keep the current objectives in view as you fly through the level and use the jet's weapons.

pages.title: 2 Player 3D City Racer
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description:
2 Player 3D City Racer takes car driving through city settings that include New York and San Francisco. Drive around the different urban environments with WASD or the arrow keys, working through the game's city levels.

The driving has no time limit, and the selected vehicle does not take accident damage. This gives you room to spend time navigating the streets and getting used to the car's handling as you travel through each city setting.

pages.title: Noob Nightmare Arcade
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description:
Noob Nightmare Arcade puts Noob into thirty-two challenges inside his dreams. Your goal is to keep him alive for fifteen seconds in each nightmare, facing situations that include balancing on a mountain and threats from Pro's UFO.

Use the left mouse button to play. Each scenario gives Noob another short survival task, with the nightmare also bringing him into conflict with Evil God. Watch the current danger and concentrate on getting through its fifteen-second challenge.

pages.title: LoL Shooting
pages.creator: Nanjing maileyou Network Technology Co., Ltd
pages.description:
LoL Shooting is a target-shooting game with faces to attack and four weapon types to use. Select a weapon and tap it to fire, working through the targets as more faces become available during progress.

Use the mouse or touch controls to interact with the interface. Try the different weapons against the face targets and continue through the growing selection. The game centers on choosing a weapon and using its attack against the faces on screen.

pages.title: Idiom Hunt
pages.creator: funky forest
pages.description:
Idiom Hunt combines word ordering with jumping through a level. Work out the idiomatic expression from its meaning, then collect its words in the correct sequence. To take a word, jump fully into it.

The words you collect appear at the top of the screen. The available words are listed in a mixed order at the bottom, alongside the expression's meaning. Use that information to plan what to collect next while avoiding the dangers in the level. Completing the phrase in the right order lets you continue through the idiom challenges.

pages.title: Gold Diggers
pages.creator: Wanted 5 Games B.V.
pages.description:
Gold Diggers asks you to dig through sand in search of gold. Click or tap the sand to open a route, avoiding obstacles as you work toward collecting as much gold as possible.

Your collection also contributes to unlocking a set of nine carts. Look at the obstacles around the gold before deciding where to dig next, choosing a route that helps you reach more of it. Keep collecting as you work toward the next cart.

pages.title: Going Balls
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description:
Going Balls is a rolling-ball challenge about balancing your movement through obstacle courses. Guide the ball along the route, adjusting its position to get past the objects that stand in the way.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, or use swipes on a touch screen. Look at the next section before changing direction so that your movement leaves room for the obstacle ahead. Keep control of the ball as you continue through the course.

pages.title: Gang Fall Party
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description:
Gang Fall Party is an arena fighting game where falling off the edge means elimination. Punch opponents to work toward first place, gaining stronger punches as you take them down. Flaming fists provide another advantage during the fight.

The game supports one- and two-player modes. Player one moves with WASD, runs with C and punches with V. Player two uses the arrow keys, O to run and P to punch. Keep track of the arena's edges while approaching an opponent so that an exchange of punches does not send your fighter out of the match.

pages.title: Police Drift & Stunt
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description:
Police Drift & Stunt gives you a police car and a city for scoring through driving tricks. Perform drifts and stunts to build your score, and modify the car as you develop the vehicle you want to drive.

Use WASD or the arrow keys to steer. F activates a boost and G enables slow motion. Look for a useful stretch of the city for the next maneuver, then use the car's movement options to work toward a higher stunt-and-drift result.

pages.title: Blaze Racing
pages.creator: Happylander Ltd
pages.description:
Blaze Racing is a survival racer on a winding cliff road. Each run generates a different track, with opponents to get past or destroy while trying to keep your own car from being knocked over the edge.

Steer with the Left and Right arrows on a computer, or tap and drag on mobile. Traveling farther earns more upgrades, connecting a longer run with developing the car. Watch the road's bends and the rivals ahead as you decide how to carry the car through the next stretch.

pages.title: Merge Fruit
pages.creator: LoraStudio
pages.description:
Merge Fruit is a dropping puzzle about combining pairs of identical fruits. Move a fruit into position and release it so that it can meet a matching one, creating a larger fruit in the merge.

Drag to change the position and click to drop. Keep developing the fruit combinations as you work toward making a big fruit of your own. Check where the matching pieces are before releasing the next one so that its placement can contribute to another merge.

pages.title: Fun Escape 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description:
Fun Escape 3D is a running race with opponents who can shove you off the route. Push other runners, avoid the moving obstacles and keep clear of the river, since the other racers can push you toward it too.

Slide to move the character. Distance contributes to your score, so keep looking for a way forward while watching the nearby competitors. Getting through the race involves managing both the obstacles ahead and the runners close enough to interfere with your movement.

pages.title: Santa Run Challenge
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description:
Santa Run Challenge sends Santa down city streets with a bag and monsters in his way. Click to make him jump over hazards, or use bag strikes against monsters as he continues the run.

Play with the mouse on a computer or the on-screen buttons on mobile. Watch the next obstacle before choosing how to get past it, keeping Santa moving along the street. His jumps and bag attacks give you different ways to deal with the dangers interrupting the journey.

pages.title: Fall Race 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description:
Fall Race 3D is a platform race against other stickmen. Keep your runner on the platforms and work toward reaching the finish in first place. Speed and a paraglider help you travel between separated sections of the course.

Drag to steer. Look at the next platform before committing to its approach, keeping track of the other racers as you continue. The challenge is bringing the runner through the gaps and onto the next stretch while maintaining a lead in the race.

pages.title: Asmr Slicing
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description:
Asmr Slicing is a cutting game about turning large fruit into juice. Slide to make cuts through the fruit resting on a platform, breaking it into pieces that fall under gravity toward the blender below.

Consider where each piece will go after a cut so that it can reach the blender. The activity follows the fruit from a whole object on the platform to smaller pieces and, finally, the juice made from them.

pages.title: Newfangled Robot Escape
pages.creator: GAMES4KING
pages.description:
Newfangled Robot Escape is a point-and-click puzzle game about freeing a trapped robot. Examine the rooms with the mouse, looking for clues and objects you can collect. Check your inventory as you go: an item found in one part of the room may help you open something elsewhere.

Look closely at locks, including ones that need a number combination, and use the clues to open doors. Each solved puzzle brings you a step closer to getting the robot out.

pages.title: Dune Surfer
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description:
Dune Surfer asks you to launch a ball over waves and bring it down in a smooth landing. A well-judged slide into the next curve sends the ball higher, increases its speed and improves the scoring multiplier.

Collect score and coins as you continue the run, focusing on how the ball approaches the next wave. The smoother the landing, the stronger the next launch can become. Use that cycle of flight and sliding landings to work toward a longer, higher-scoring attempt.

pages.title: Shoot the Duck
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description:
Shoot the Duck is a hunting game about hitting flying ducks during each round. Watch the lower panel for the target count and shoot as the ducks move across the scene, working toward completing the current round's requirement.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, and fire with Space or a tap on the screen. Watch the direction of the flying targets before taking the next shot so that you can keep adding hits to the round's total.

pages.title: Zombie Exorcist
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description:
Zombie Exorcist is a shooting puzzle about destroying every zombie with a limited supply of bullets. Aim each shot carefully and use ricochets to send bullets toward the targets you need to hit.

Tap the screen to aim and fire. Look at how a rebound will change the bullet's path before using another round, since the ammunition limit makes each shot count. Clear the zombies while working toward a better score with the shots available.

pages.title: Neon War
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description:
Neon War puts you in charge of a cannon firing at numbered orbs. Touch and drag to move the cannon, lining up its shots with the targets. An orb's number tells you how many hits it needs before it explodes.

Read the numbers as you choose what to fire at next. Targets requiring more hits need more attention from the cannon, making its position part of managing the shooting. Keep moving it into line with the orbs you want to destroy.

pages.title: Soldier Bridge
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description:
Soldier Bridge is a gap-crossing challenge in which a soldier uses a stick as a temporary bridge. Adjust the stick's length with the mouse or touch controls so that it spans the space and gives the soldier a safe crossing.

Judge the gap and landing position before setting the bridge. The length needs to suit the crossing: an inaccurate bridge can leave the soldier falling into the abyss. Work out the distance before making the next attempt to carry him across.

pages.title: Space Shooter
pages.creator: Mind Games
pages.description:
Space Shooter puts you in a spaceship fighting aliens descending toward you. Move the ship and fire at the approaching enemies as you work through the game's missions and boss encounters.

Equipment upgrades include shields and weapons such as guns, missiles and lasers. Develop your defenses and attacks while continuing the space battles, watching how the enemies approach before choosing where to move and direct your fire. The task is overcoming the invading forces through the mission levels.

pages.title: Wild animal hunting
pages.creator: mastergame
pages.description:
Wild animal hunting is a first-person hunting game set in a jungle environment. Move through the area and use your weapon to shoot the wild animals, looking for a clear view of the target before firing.

The arrow keys control movement. Use the right mouse button to focus your aim and the left to fire. Check where the animal is before taking the shot so that you can line up the weapon as you move through the jungle.

pages.title: Pedal Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description:
Pedal Cars Jigsaw gives you pictures of children's pedal cars to rebuild from puzzle pieces. Choose an image and drag its fragments into their proper positions until the complete car picture is assembled.

Use the mouse to move the pieces. Compare the colors and outlines in each fragment with the areas around it as you work out where it belongs. Continue positioning the remaining pieces to finish the selected pedal-car scene.

pages.title: Puppet Hockey Battle
pages.creator: playfreeonline.games
pages.description:
Puppet Hockey Battle is a one-on-one ice-hockey game with country teams to choose from. Select your team, move around the ice and shoot the puck into the opposing goal while working toward the trophy.

Use the arrow keys to move and F to shoot. A tied match gives you twenty additional seconds to score and win; if the tie remains after extra time, you lose. Winning the full set of matches leads to another round against the teams. Watch the puck and your opponent's position as you look for the next scoring opportunity.

pages.title: Fruit Slicing
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description:
Fruit Slicing is a timed arcade game about swiping through fruit to build your score. Some fruits need two or more cuts before they are destroyed, so watch which pieces still need another slice.

Bombs deduct points if you cut them. Special items provide advantages, including banana items for bonus points and clock items with a slowing effect. Choose a swipe that reaches the fruit you want while keeping clear of bombs, and continue slicing before the available time runs out.

pages.title: Time To Park
pages.creator: SDV Imants Klava
pages.description:
Time To Park asks you to drive through city streets and stop in marked parking spaces. Keep the car on the road, steering around other vehicles and obstacles as you approach the designated spot.

Drive with the arrow keys or the on-screen buttons. Look at the space ahead before turning into the parking area so that the car can line up with the marker. The task combines getting through the streets with bringing the vehicle accurately into position.

pages.title: Volvo Trucks Coloring
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description:
Volvo Trucks Coloring gives you eight truck pictures to color. Choose an image and work with the colors you want, changing the brush size to suit the area you are painting.

Use the mouse to color the truck. An eraser lets you remove marks you want to change, and a save option keeps the colored image when you have finished. Combine the palette's colors as you develop the picture, then save the result or choose another truck to work on.

pages.title: Monster Run
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description:
Monster Run is a jumping runner about avoiding hazards and collecting stars. Click or tap to jump, keeping clear of obstacles and saws that threaten the monster from either side of the screen.

The stars you gather can be used for different monsters at the end of a level. Watch both sides before the next jump so that collecting another star does not put you into a saw or obstacle. Work through the run while building the collection for your next monster choice.

pages.title: Aquapark game
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Aquapark game is a water-park race where you slide to steer your character through the course. Choose a racer and try to reach the finish ahead of the other competitors. Keep racing to earn coins and improve your rank. Those rewards let you unlock more characters and maps, giving you new courses to try.

pages.title: Barber Shop!
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description:
Barber Shop! puts you behind the clippers as customers arrive for a haircut. Use the mouse or touch controls to trim the hair toward the style the current guest wants.

Keep the clipper on the areas you need to cut, since touching other parts of the customer can hurt them. Follow the requested hairstyle as you work around its shape, choosing where to trim next so that the haircut matches the customer's intended look.

pages.title: Eat.io Online
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description:
In Eat.io Online, you drag a moving hole around the map to swallow objects. Start with things small enough to fit, then go after larger targets as your hole grows. You can even swallow rival holes once yours is big enough.

Drag with the mouse or your finger to steer. Each round is timed, so look for clusters of objects you can reach quickly and see how much you can collect before the clock runs out.

pages.title: Word Jumble
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Word Jumble gives you scrambled words and asks you to put the letters back in order. Click two letters to swap their positions, then make more swaps until the word reads correctly. Picture or text hints can help you figure out what the letters should spell. In timed mode, see how many words you can unscramble before the clock runs out.

pages.title: Circle Loop Drive
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description:
Circle Loop Drive is a driving challenge about completing circuits while avoiding other cars. Manage your car's speed with the mouse controls, watching the nearby traffic so that you can keep going without a collision.

Each completed circuit adds points. Look at where the other vehicles are before changing speed, considering the part of the circle you are about to reach. The goal is to keep the car safe while completing more laps and improving your score.

pages.title: Kids Camping Hidden Stars
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description:
Kids Camping Hidden Stars hides ten stars in each camping picture. Click or tap the star shapes as you find them, searching the image before the time limit expires. There are six levels to finish.

Repeated selections in the wrong places remove an extra five seconds from the timer. Examine the picture's small details before making a choice so that guesses do not use up your search time. Find the full set of stars in the current scene to continue through the camping pictures.

pages.title: Halloween 2019 Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
Halloween 2019 Slide is a picture-sliding puzzle with three Halloween images to choose from. Select a picture and one of three modes, then rearrange its tiles to restore the complete scene.

Use the mouse to play. Compare the details on neighboring tiles as you work out where the parts of the picture belong. Choose another mode or image when you want to work on a different sliding arrangement.

pages.title: Fantasy Sword Memory
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description:
Fantasy Sword Memory is a four-level card-matching game with fantasy themes. Click or tap a tile to reveal its picture, then locate another tile with the same image. Match all the pairs to complete the level.

Try to clear the board in as few moves as possible. Keep track of the pictures you uncover and their positions so that a later reveal can lead you back to the right partner. Work through the remaining matches until the whole arrangement is paired.

pages.title: Fantasy Connect Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Fantasy Connect Deluxe is a timed matching game played by tracing chains of similar blocks. Press on a piece, move through adjacent matching items and release when you have selected the chain you want to clear for points.

Groups of seven or ten provide power-ups, giving you a reason to look for longer connections. Check the neighboring pieces before starting a chain so that you can plan how to extend it. Build your score through the matches you can make before time runs out.

pages.title: Summer Fun Fashion
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description:
Summer Fun Fashion is a styling game featuring Bella and Ella. Choose summer makeup and outfits for the two characters, working on the appearance you want each of them to wear.

Use the mouse to make selections. Combine the cosmetics and clothing choices as you develop their looks, then compare how the different pieces work together. The activity centers on putting together a summer style for Bella and another for Ella.

pages.title: 3D Ball Fall
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description:
3D Ball Fall is a descending arcade challenge about reaching the bottom of each level. Tap to drop down, finding a route that keeps clear of the black blocks along the way.

Combos contribute to a higher score as you continue the descent. Look at the next section before dropping so that you can keep progressing toward the bottom while avoiding the black obstacles. Finish the descent to complete the level.

pages.title: Super Sniper Assassin
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Super Sniper Assassin gives you the objective of shooting every target. Aim at the targets and click to fire, working toward eliminating the full set. Check where you want the shot to land before clicking so that you can focus on the next target still to be hit.

pages.title: EG Strike Galaxy
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Strike Galaxy is a space shooter viewed from above, with an invading army to defeat. Use the mouse controls to fight the enemies as you work toward clearing the galactic invaders. Watch their shapes and approach closely so that you can react to the next threat during the battle.

pages.title: EG Sweet World
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description:
EG Sweet World is a timed puzzle about tracing chains of matching sweets. Connect at least three pieces of the same kind to clear them. You can trace a chain across, down, or diagonally, so a match can continue even when the next sweet sits on a different row.

Each piece beyond the first three adds a second to the clock. Look for longer chains to clear more sweets and buy yourself time to spot the next match.

pages.title: Shoot Balls
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Shoot Balls challenges you to break targets on towers by firing balls at them. Watch the rotating parts to see when the targets are open, then time your shots to get through. Each step has a set of targets to clear. Pay attention to the movement around the next tower as you work through the level.

pages.title: Flip The Knife 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description:
Flip The Knife 3D is a throwing game about sending a weapon upward, making it flip and landing it with its point facing down. Use the mouse to control the throws and work toward the required landing.

The objects include axes and other weapons alongside knives. Watch how the current weapon rotates as you judge the next throw, trying to finish the flip in position for its downward landing.

pages.title: Legends Basketball Stars
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Legends Basketball Stars challenges you to aim basketball shots and send them through the hoop. Use the trajectory preview to see the arc before you throw, then adjust your aim if the ball looks likely to miss. There are four maps to play on. Choose Time Attack to score against the clock or No Time to take your shots at your own pace.

pages.title: Dune
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: In Dune, you guide a ball across a series of sand dunes. Get enough lift to cross the scoring line, then aim for a smooth landing on a slope so you can keep rolling into the next jump. A higher jump gives you farther to fall, and a rough landing can end the run. Keep playing to reach score and landing milestones that unlock different ball designs.

pages.title: Kids Cartoon Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description:
Kids Cartoon Coloring Book gives you cartoon pictures to paint with colors from a palette. Choose the shade you want and apply it to the drawing, building your own colored version of the picture.

Move between the available colors as you work through the drawing, deciding which areas should share a shade and which should have a different color.

pages.title: Spidey Swing
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Spidey Swing is a web-swinging challenge about reaching the finish while keeping most of Spidey's body intact. Shoot webs, grab on and swing through the course, staying clear of sharp edges, rotating chainsaws, arrows and other dangerous objects.

Look at the hazards ahead before committing to the next swing. Your web attachments provide a way through the route, but the movement still needs to carry Spidey safely past the objects in his path. Work toward the finish with as little damage as you can.

pages.title: Princess Love Test
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description:
Princess Love Test is a playful matchmaking game about a princess and a potential partner. Enter a name for the princess and another for the male candidate, then choose their zodiac signs and let the game produce a compatibility result.

Read the game's imagined outcome for the pair, from a promising romance to a disappointing first date. The activity centers on choosing the two names and signs and seeing the relationship story generated for those characters.

pages.title: Superhero Spring Dress up!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description:
Superhero Spring Dress up! lets you help Ellie and Annie choose new spring looks. Work with the clothing and accessories to put together an outfit for each superhero princess.

Compare the available pieces as you decide what the two characters should wear. Coordinate the accessories with their clothes and develop the spring style you want for Ellie and for Annie as they get ready for the season.

pages.title: Princess Exotic Holiday!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description:
Princess Exotic Holiday! is a dress-up game featuring Rapunzel, Barbie and Belle. Help the three characters choose swimwear and summer outfits for their holiday, putting together a different look for each of them.

Work through the clothing choices and decide what the characters should wear for the trip. Combine the available pieces into the holiday styles you want, keeping each character's outfit in mind as you move between the three friends.

pages.title: Princesses Burger Cooking
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princesses Burger Cooking is a food-customization game about preparing a hamburger for princesses. Choose the ingredients you want to include and put together the burger you would like to serve. Look through the available choices and decide how to combine them into the finished hamburger.
